content.text: This is a clear tainted data flow from `request.getHeaders()` through a list manipulation into `Runtime.exec()`.

input.justification: The header value "BenchmarkTest00307" is read via request.getHeaders(), URL-decoded, placed into a list and retrieved again (no actual sanitization, just data movement), then concatenated into a string passed directly to Runtime.exec(cmd + bar, argsEnv). There is no validation, allow-listing, or escaping of the user-controlled value before it reaches the command execution sink, so an attacker controlling the HTTP header can inject OS commands.
